concept: VPC endpoints: S3/DynamoDB gateway endpoints instead of NAT (savings)
tests: How to cut NAT Gateway data processing charges for EC2 traffic to S3 and DynamoDB in the same Region.
expected: Create Gateway VPC endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB: a private route with no per-GB charge, traffic bypasses the NAT Gateway. Triggers: "NAT Gateway data processing charges", "S3 and DynamoDB", "same Region", "MOST cost-effective".
why_not: More NAT Gateways cost more; IGW and public subnets expose instances and don't solve it privately.
